title: Etale compact-support composition on a pullback compactification tower
statement: Use a finite commutative ring A, ordinary small-etale A-module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let sq be a Cartesian square X′ --v′--> X, f′:X′->Y′, f:X->Y, v:Y′->Y, between Noetherian schemes; assume all four arrows separated and finite type, v,v′ etale, and compactifications for them and their two equal composites. Use the explicitly constructed canonical graph comparison d_e:F_e -> S_e of [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism], after the chosen-model identification of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. For a compactification c=(j,p) of f, let c′=(j′,p′) be its pullback and b its ambient horizontal etale arrow. Set J=Dj!, J′=Dj′!, P=Rp*, Q=Rp′*, S_e=D(e_{Sigma!}) with the actual sum/evaluation adjunction of [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Let tau:v* p′* -> p* b* be the exact inverse-image square comparison of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. Let sumEx:p′* S_b -> S_v p* be its inverse mate under S_v adjoint v* and S_b adjoint b*, and assume sumEx invertible. Let Gamma:Q S_v -> S_b P be the right-adjoint mate of inv(sumEx) under p′* adjoint Q and p* adjoint P. Let a:J′ S_b -> S_v′ J be the composite-left-adjoint comparison conjugate to the inverse-image square for j,j′,v′,b. Let t:JP -> F_f, t′:J′Q -> F_f′ be the model-to-chosen comparisons, where F_e=Re! and all composition and congruence isomorphisms are those of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Form delta:S_v′ F_f -> F_f′ S_v by d_v′ inverse, alpha_(v′,f), congruence for v′ f=f′ v, alpha_(f′,v) inverse, and d_v, with the indicated whiskerings. For every M in D(X′_et,A), delta.inv at M equals S_v(t′.inv at M), followed by Gamma at J′(M), followed by P(a at M), followed by t at S_v′(M). This is a canonical graph composition normalization before either horizontal counit. It does not involve inverse proper exchange or the full compact-support base-change map of f.

source.place: Tags 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open) and 0F7F (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change): the proper/quasi-finite interchange map computed by K-injective resolutions, and its compatibility with change of base. Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition): the proper/open tower and independence of its choices. Tag 0F7L (lemma-base-change-shriek), final proof paragraph item (3): compatibility with these composition maps. Specialize the horizontal maps to separated etale maps and identify their proper-support functors by the constructed graph comparison of etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L. This is the geometric normalization before counits.

proof.text: Put r=v′c.i and take e=d.ofComp c for the chosen compactification d of v′f. Construct k:S_r Rp_*→F_rp explicitly from the canonical graph comparison for e, proper direct-image composition, and the chosen-model comparison. Normalize the etale-first composition by lem-pur-etale-graph-open-tower, and the proper-first composition by lem-pur-etale-graph-proper-tower. These supply two separate paths to the common graph model.

The two congruence isomorphisms to F_rp compose to the original congruence v′f=f′v. Thus delta inverse followed by l equals rho, by cancellation of the etale graph comparisons and compact-support compositors. Postcompose the desired component equality by the invertible l. Substitute the open normalization, cancel P(a.hom) against P(a.inv), use the proper normalization, and cancel S_v(t′.inv) against S_v(t′.hom). This is a complete calculation of actual derived morphisms and needs no cohomology or stalk detection.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7F, 0F7J and 0F7L, as the two separate geometric tower normalizations. The remaining proof is cancellation at their common graph compactification.

theorem etaleHorizontalSupport_tower
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Y']
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {v : Y' ⟶ Y} {v' : X' ⟶ X}
    [IsSeparated f] [IsSeparated f'] [IsSeparated v] [IsSeparated v']
    [Etale v] [Etale v'] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f']
    [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiCompact v] [QuasiCompact v']
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f'] [HasCompactification v]
    [HasCompactification v'] [HasCompactification (v' ≫ f)]
    [HasCompactification (f' ≫ v)] [QuasiCompact (v' ≫ f)]
    [QuasiCompact (f' ≫ v)] (sq : IsPullback v' f' f v)
    (c : Compactification f)
    [IsIso (((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (pullback.fst c.g v) inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g v).toCommSq).hom)).natTrans)]
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X') :
    let cs := c.ofIsPullback sq
    let va := derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v' inferInstance
    let ba := derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (pullback.fst c.g v) inferInstance
    let ja := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i
    let j'a := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cs.i
    let a := (conjugateIsoEquiv (va.comp ja) (j'a.comp ba)).symm
      (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback sq).toCommSq.flip)
    let sumEx := ((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (pullback.fst c.g v) inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g v).toCommSq).hom)).natTrans
    let gam := (mateEquiv
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (pullback.snd c.g v))
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv sumEx))).natTrans
    let dv' := (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
      (HasCompactification.compactification v')).symm ≪≫
        canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A v' (HasCompactification.compactification v')
    let dv := (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
      (HasCompactification.compactification v)).symm ≪≫
        canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A v (HasCompactification.compactification v)
    let delta := Functor.isoWhiskerRight dv'.symm
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ≪≫
        unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A v' f ≪≫
        unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A sq.toCommSq.w ≪≫
        (unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A f' v).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f') dv
    delta.inv.app M =
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A cs).inv.app M) ≫
        gam.app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cs.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).map
          (a.hom.app M) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c).hom.app
          ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v' inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
